description: This file defines the AWS FreeTierClient class for interacting with the AWS Free Tier service, extending the AwsClient class and specifying methods for getting free tier usage information synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: FreeTierClient
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the AWS Free Tier service, inheriting behavior from AwsClient.

methods.description: Method to asynchronously retrieve Free Tier usage information.
